notes:
V3.2.0 — broker-mode selector + slot-based API keys in Tools.

⛁  BROKER MODE
• New chip in the app header — left of the credits chip — lets you switch the active broker between Alpaca / IBKR / TradingView. Each mode has a distinct Tools page.
• Current state: Alpaca is the only one wired end-to-end (bots route orders through Alpaca's paper API). IBKR + TradingView show a 'COMING VERY SOON' placeholder with a brief note about what they'll do.
• The choice persists in apex_settings.json under 'broker_mode'.

🔑  ALPACA — SLOT-BASED KEYS
• The Tools tab no longer hardcodes LONG / SHORT / DAY into the API-key field labels. Instead three numbered SLOTS appear, each with its own API key + secret fields + an 'Assigned' dropdown (Unassigned / LONG / SHORT / DAY).
• Save translates the dropdown choices into the underlying ALPACA_API_KEY_{side} env vars the bot code already reads, so existing bots keep working unmodified. Reassigning bots without re-typing keys is now a couple of clicks.
• Duplicate-assignment guard: if two slots target the same bot, the second is ignored with a warning.
• Anthropic / Claude key has its own card (it's used by every bot regardless of broker mode, so it stays out of the slot grid).

Non-Alpaca modes show a clean COMING-SOON card with a brief explanation. The mode-selector chip lets you flip back to Alpaca with one click.
